svg.title: KAY CRM MLD
svg.desc: Logical model of fifty tables, selected primary and foreign keys, split into eleven domains.
svg.text: Tables, selected primary/foreign keys and integrity boundaries for the complete CRM.
Documented target model / implementation is partial

g.text: One agency, named staff, revocable sessions and safe command receipts.
Existing ORM/migration tables are solid. Planned tables are dashed.
Rate limiting uses an HMAC key; it has no direct user foreign key.
A lead is an enquiry, not a second copy of the contact.
Active E.164 phone is unique; one primary per non-empty collection.
Contact roles do not grant staff permissions. Transfer keeps true authorship.
Reusable types describe units; only actual properties count as stock.
Standalone property: development/floor/type links are all NULL.
Apartment unit: same-development floor and type required. Mixed projects allowed.
Separate commercial campaigns for one property or a whole development.
Offering target XOR: exactly one of property_id or development_id.
One current sale and one current rental per target. Multiple owners allowed.
Independent needs, explicit criteria and exact offering matches.
Criterion importance: required or preferred. Unknown values remain NULL.
Monthly rental annual equivalent = amount × 12; original terms are retained.
Fixed pipeline, explicit holds and append-only close/reopen history.
One active reservation per offering; no automatic reservation expiry.
Project/unit overlap is checked under locks. Closing effects are transactional.

g.data-domain: Visit calendar and dynamic working times
g.text: Visit calendar and dynamic working times
Office anytime; off-site within working windows; company-car capacity only.
Policy belongs to the agency; only an administrator may edit it.
Capacity counts every local hour intersected by [start,end), end excluded.

g.data-domain: Activity, tasks and durable background work
g.text: Activity, tasks and durable background work
True actors, internal notifications and retriable PostgreSQL jobs/outbox.
Typed context FKs preserve contact/deal/property integrity; no generic IDs.
Business effect + history + outbox commit together; dedupe keys prevent repeats.

g.data-domain: Private documents and temporary file access
g.text: Private documents and temporary file access
Exactly one real parent; quarantine precedes every protected download.
Document parent XOR: contact, development, property or deal.
Owner/developer private evidence stays on contact; permits bind session/resource.
Manager-controlled recognition, receipts and linked corrections.
Commission is optional. Balance is derived, never directly editable.
Reject over-collection. Original records remain; final MAD rounding is once.

g.data-domain: Atomic import, website intake and retry safety
g.text: Atomic import, website intake and retry safety
Preview/correction before one commit; replay-safe website receipts.
Existing phone rows are skipped and reported; invalid rows block approval.
No partial batch. Retry records preserve request identity and original result.
Reference boxes repeat a table without duplicating it.
Right column: type or referenced table.column.
Fields and lines are selected, not exhaustive DDL.
UUID identifiers; version checks; UTC timestamps.
Join/receipt keys may be composite; NULL is unknown.
History FKs restrict deletion; archive is recoverable.

Diagram styling: user-approved KAY ivory / charcoal / gold. No credentials, client records or live database data.
